description:
Characters tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- influencer_options: List the AI Influencer builder's trait groups and options, looks, sheet layouts, price tiers (draft|pro) and limits.
- influencer_presets: List the starter AI Influencer recipes (name, traits, look, prompt) with a recreateUrl that opens the builder prefilled.
- create_influencer_sheet: Design an original adult AI Influencer from traits and generate its character sheet (1-4 sheets).
- save_sheet_as_element: Turn a finished AI Influencer sheet (a `job_item_id` from characters.get_identity_job) into a People element: crops the portrait and full-bo
- run_identity_shoot: Photo set of ONE ready People element (same face across scenes): packs photodump (8), city-week (8), studio (4), headshots (6) or custom `lo
- get_identity_job: Poll every 10-20 seconds until status is done, partial or failed.
- list_characters: List the signed-in user's Draftless characters (Soul-ID identities) used for consistent talent across UGC, ads, and storyboards.
- create_character: Create a new Draftless character (Soul-ID identity) from pre-hosted reference image URLs.
- update_character: Update an existing Draftless character (Soul-ID identity).
- delete_character: Permanently delete a Draftless character (Soul-ID identity).
- render_avatar: Character-locked talking avatar: takes a character_id and either audio_url or script_text.
- render_lipsync: Lipsync a source VIDEO to an audio track.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
